description: Build the evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts and visualise the provenance of the SERPINA6 GO:0004867 annotation
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
pd.set_option("display.width",260); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",70)

# ---------------- Evidence matrix (artifact) ----------------
ev=[
 dict(citation="PMID:3143075 (Pemberton 1988, Nature)",type="direct assay / biophysical",
      stance="REFUTES",claim="CBG retains serpin protease inhibitory activity",
      finding="TBG and CBG retain the stressed native S conformation and the S-to-R transition, but 'there is no evidence of any retained protease inhibitory activity'",
      context="human plasma CBG and TBG, purified protein",conf="High; foundational, no quantitative Ki reported"),
 dict(citation="PMID:27339896 (Sumer-Bayraktar 2016, MCP)",type="direct assay",
      stance="REFUTES / qualifies",claim="CBG inhibits neutrophil elastase",
      finding="NE cleaves CBG RCL at Val344-Thr345 in seconds to minutes; CBG is consumed as a substrate, no inhibition reported",
      context="human blood-derived CBG + human neutrophil elastase and P. aeruginosa LasB, in vitro",conf="High; LC-MS/MS time course"),
 dict(citation="PMID:23300763 (Gardill 2012, JBC)",type="structural",
      stance="qualifies",claim="CBG performs the serpin S-to-R loop insertion",
      finding="Human CBG cleaved RCL inserts into beta-sheet A; cleaved segment is 5 residues longer than anticipated; rat CBG fails to undergo S-to-R at all",
      context="2.5 A crystal structure, E. coli-produced human and rat CBG",conf="High; shows insertion competence but non-canonical cleavage site and species divergence"),
 dict(citation="PMID:19011238 (Lin 2009, JBC)",type="mutant phenotype (in vitro)",
      stance="qualifies",claim="CBG RCL hinge functions as an inhibitory hinge",
      finding="P15/P14/P12 substitutions block loop re-orientation; readout is steroid binding after cleavage, never protease inhibition",
      context="recombinant human CBG variants + neutrophil elastase",conf="High; the assayed output is hormone release, not inhibition"),
 dict(citation="PMID:24424442 + PMID:28411181 (Lewis & Elder)",type="direct assay",
      stance="REFUTES",claim="CBG inhibits chymotrypsin / elastase",
      finding="Chymotrypsin and NE rapidly cleave the CBG RCL to completion, releasing cortisol; antibodies that block the RCL protect CBG from the proteases",
      context="human serum / plasma, purified CBG",conf="High; CBG is consumed, protease activity not reduced"),
 dict(citation="PMID:24848868 (Simard 2014, Endocrinology)",type="direct assay",
      stance="qualifies",claim="CBG RCL is a protease-inhibitor reactive site",
      finding="P. aeruginosa metalloprotease LasB cleaves the CBG RCL and destroys cortisol binding; serpins do not inhibit metalloproteases",
      context="human serum CBG + bacterial culture media",conf="Medium-high; shows RCL is a generic substrate loop"),
 dict(citation="PMID:3299377 (Hammond 1987, PNAS)",type="computational / sequence",
      stance="SOURCE OF ANNOTATION",claim="CBG is a serine protease inhibitor",
      finding="Sequence similarity of CBG to alpha-1-antitrypsin and the serpin superfamily; no inhibition assay performed",
      context="human liver and lung cDNA",conf="High that this is homology only; cited as TAS for GO:0004867"),
 dict(citation="This work (UniProt + QuickGO + alignment)",type="computational",
      stance="REFUTES / qualifies",claim="CBG is mechanically capable of serpin inhibition",
      finding="Structural P1 = Thr349/Ser350 (mature), validated 6/6 vs PMID:19011238 numbering; NE cuts at P6-P5; hinge 6/7 (insertion-competent) but P14=Val vs Thr/Ser/Ala in 7/7 inhibitory serpins; UniProt annotates no 'Reactive bond' for P08185, P05543, P01019, P36955 but does for all 7 inhibitory serpins",
      context="in silico, 12 serpins",conf="Medium-high; alignment-transferred anchors, PCI anchor slipped 3 aa vs UniProt"),
 dict(citation="PMID:19643161 / PMID:27214312 / PMID:27411675",type="review",
      stance="REFUTES",claim="CBG has protease inhibitor activity",
      finding="All three independently state CBG is a non-inhibitory member of the serpin family whose function is glucocorticoid transport",
      context="review-level synthesis",conf="Medium; review-level, but authored by the structural and clinical primary groups"),
]
em=pd.DataFrame(ev)
print("="*120); print("EVIDENCE MATRIX: does SERPINA6 enable GO:0004867 (serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity)?"); print("="*120)
for _,r in em.iterrows():
    print(f"\n[{r.stance}] {r.citation}  ({r['type']})")
    print(f"   claim tested : {r.claim}")
    print(f"   key finding  : {r.finding}")
    print(f"   context      : {r.context}")
    print(f"   confidence   : {r.conf}")
em.to_csv("serpina6_evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)

# ---------------- GO decision table (artifact) ----------------
go=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(term="GO:0004867 serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity",aspect="MF",
      current="IBA GO_REF:0000033 (+ IEA GO_REF:0000002, TAS PMID:3299377)",
      recommended_action="REMOVE / do not accept",
      basis="All support is homology over the serpin fold; PMID:3143075 states no retained inhibitory activity; no Ki, SI or SDS-stable complex exists"),
 dict(term="GO:0005496 steroid binding",aspect="MF",current="IDA PMID:18513745",
      recommended_action="RETAIN as core",basis="Direct experimental steroid binding; the actual molecular function"),
 dict(term="GO:0140104 molecular carrier activity",aspect="MF",current="EXP PMID:7195404",
      recommended_action="RETAIN; consider child term for glucocorticoid transport",
      basis="CBG is the principal plasma cortisol carrier (>90% of circulating cortisol)"),
 dict(term="GO:0005496 -> consider GO:1990239 steroid hormone binding / glucocorticoid binding",aspect="MF",
      current="not present",recommended_action="LEAD: add a more specific steroid-binding child",
      basis="Cortisol/progesterone affinities measured by SPR across 19 steroids (PMID:33085168)"),
 dict(term="endopeptidase inhibitor activity, NOT qualifier",aspect="MF",current="n/a",
      recommended_action="LEAD: if GO policy prefers retention, annotate with NOT qualifier",
      basis="Explicit negative statement in PMID:3143075 supports a NOT annotation rather than silent removal"),
 dict(term="GO:0006953 acute-phase response / cortisol transport BP",aspect="BP",current="not evaluated here",
      recommended_action="LEAD only",basis="Protease-triggered cortisol release at inflamed tissue; BP scope outside this hypothesis"),
])
print("\n"+"="*120); print("GO CURATION DECISION TABLE (leads requiring curator verification)"); print("="*120)
print(go.to_string(index=False))
go.to_csv("serpina6_go_decision_table.csv",index=False)

# ---------------- summary figure ----------------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14.5,5.5))
ax=axes[0]
cnt=em.stance.str.split(" / ").str[0].value_counts()
order=["REFUTES","qualifies","SOURCE OF ANNOTATION"]
vals=[cnt.get(o,0) for o in order]
ax.bar(["refutes\ninhibitor activity","qualifies\n(mechanism)","is the homology\nsource"],vals,
       color=["#8a1c3b","#c0893b","#6b6b6b"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+0.05,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel("evidence items"); ax.set_ylim(0,5.6)
ax.set_title("Evidence items bearing on GO:0004867 for SERPINA6\n(0 items support direct inhibitor activity)",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]; ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("Evidence provenance of SERPINA6 GO:0004867",fontsize=10)
rows=[("IEA  GO_REF:0000002  InterPro","serpin domain match","homology"),
      ("IBA  GO_REF:0000033  GO_Central","ancestral node propagation","homology"),
      ("TAS  PMID:3299377    PINC","cDNA sequence similarity to A1AT","homology"),
      ("IDA  PMID:18513745   (GO:0005496)","measured steroid binding","EXPERIMENT"),
      ("EXP  PMID:7195404    (GO:0140104)","cortisol carrier","EXPERIMENT")]
for i,(a,b,c) in enumerate(rows):
    y=0.82-i*0.16
    col="#8a1c3b" if c=="homology" else "#2e7d4f"
    ax.text(0.01,y,a,family="monospace",fontsize=9)
    ax.text(0.50,y,b,fontsize=9)
    ax.text(0.90,y,c,fontsize=9,color=col,weight="bold")
ax.text(0.01,0.06,"No evidence line for GO:0004867 is experimental.",fontsize=10,weight="bold",color="#8a1c3b")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nsaved serpina6_evidence_matrix.csv, serpina6_go_decision_table.csv")
